purpose: Two background prototypes requested by user: flat calm lake and no waterfalls.

prototypes.description: Heller, klarer türkisfarbener See mit sichtbarem Grund am Ufer.
prototypes.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: background prototype 1 for the fantasy mining game Tiefenhall.
Input image: EDIT TARGET. Preserve the original full 16:9 framing, camera, cavern architecture, bridges, lanterns, blue crystals, right foreground dock, foreground rocks and left mining equipment.
Requested changes:
1. REMOVE EVERY WATERFALL AND CASCADE COMPLETELY. Replace both the large white cascading waterfall on the center-left beneath the bridge and the waterfall in the distant center-right with solid dry natural cave rock. Remove all streams, falling water, splash, white foam and waterfall spray at their bases. There are NO waterfalls anywhere, including in the far distance.
2. COMPLETELY REPAINT THE ENTIRE LAKE SURFACE AS STILL, FLAT, GLASS-SMOOTH WATER. This is more than removing droplet rings: eliminate ALL the existing small waves, horizontal ripple lines, zigzag reflected streaks, corrugated surface texture and concentric rings. The lake must look motionless and sheltered from wind, like a smooth sheet of glass.
Prototype 1 treatment: a luminous clear turquoise cave lake, transparent near the shore so submerged stones are visible through an undistorted surface. Reflections of the blue crystals and warm lanterns should be smooth continuous shapes on the flat water, gently soft but NOT broken into stripes. Use broad subtle color gradients rather than any wave texture. The surface is visually very quiet and almost perfectly level.
Preserve the painterly high-quality fantasy illustration style and existing blue-versus-amber lighting. Keep the lake occupying the same area and all objects in the same locations, apart from replacing the waterfalls with rock. Calm dry cavern atmosphere; only faint distant atmospheric haze, no spray or active mist plumes. No people, added objects, UI, text, logos, labels, crop or zoom. No waves, ripples, rings, drops, foam, streams or waterfalls.

prototypes.description: Dunkler, ruhiger blaugrüner See mit dezenten Spiegelungen.
prototypes.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: background prototype 2 for the fantasy mining game Tiefenhall.
Input image: EDIT TARGET. Retain the exact full landscape framing and cavern composition: wooden left foreground with lantern and mining tools, blue crystals, suspended wooden bridges, distant cave opening, rocky banks and right foreground dock.
Primary changes: remove ALL waterfalls, cascades and flowing streams, and replace the WHOLE textured lake surface with completely calm, nearly mirror-flat water. Fill the former center-left waterfall below the bridge and the distant center-right waterfall with convincing dry rocky cliff formations that continue the surrounding geology. Remove white waterfall plumes, foaming pools, spray and bright falling water in every part of the cave.
Prototype 2: make the quiet lake a deeper, darker blue-teal than in the original, conveying sheltered underground depth. A broad glass-smooth surface with understated, softly mirrored silhouettes of the cave and bridge and subdued blue crystal and amber lamp reflections. Gentle large-scale tonal gradients only. Reflections should be uninterrupted soft vertical forms, NOT jagged broken lines. Reduce the intensity and visual busyness of the water reflections. Only a slim shallow turquoise margin near the closest rocky shore reveals a few submerged stones; the main center of the lake remains deep blue and visually very calm.
Crucial: NO horizontal wave bands, NO water ripple texture, NO concentric circles, NO tiny repeating lines, NO splash, NO drop, NO foam, NO waterfall anywhere. Completely erase the original lake's corrugated and striped reflection texture. The water should resemble a still sheltered mountain lake on an absolutely windless day.
Keep all existing architecture, crystals, dock, objects, cave perspective, painterly rendering quality and overall warm amber / cool blue lighting. Do not change the framing or crop. No people, text, UI, logos or labels, and no added objects. Deliver the complete 16:9 background illustration.

status: Prototype 2 approved and integrated into Assets/Resources/Homescreen/CaveLake.png. Flat water rendering; no waterfall or continuous wave displacement.
